sql: SELECT TOP 10 ps.SKU AS sku, ps.ParentSKU AS parentSku, ps.ParentZnodeProductId AS productId, ps.ParentName AS productName FROM cso.ProductSearch ps INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = ps.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pc.PortalId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND ps.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.ParentZnodeProductId IS NOT NULL AND ps.ParentSKU IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ps.ParentZnodeProductId, ps.SKU
